other_conditions: The nominee must be a distinguished resident Indian scientist or academician in STEM or Medicine, particularly during the last 10 years.
The nominee must be recognized as a Science Leader with fellowships or awards from national or international scientific bodies.
The nominee should not hold any administrative roles or functions.
The nominee must not be receiving any honorarium, fellowship, or salary from any other institute or organization at the time of initiation of the award.
The nominee should have consent from the future host institution or be affiliated with an academic institution/R&D lab.
benefits_summary: ₹1.5 lakhs per month fellowship, ₹5 lakhs research grant per annum and ₹1 lakh per annum overhead provided to the host institution.
